name: Nebula Coral Atoll
description: A floating atoll in deep space where coral formations glow with nebular gases, creating a living reef of color among the stars.
prompt: Zero‑gravity atoll composed of massive coral-like structures, each pulsing with swirling nebula clouds — pinks, blues, purples. Tiny luminous fish‑like creatures drift. Background starfield with distant galaxies. Wide view, vibrant volumetric lighting, 8k, surreal sci‑fi aesthetic.
caption: A reef that lives in the breath of galaxies. 🌌🪸 #NebulaCoralAtoll
